input.command:
cd /workspace/tome4-chinese-translation; python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
e=json.load(open('.ai/task/repair-w31-20260925/CONTEXTUAL-ENVELOPE-f3a2.json'))
p=e['payload']
for i,(t,c) in enumerate(zip(p['translation_snapshot'],p['bounded_context'])):
    cx=json.loads(c['context']) if c['context'] else {}
    se=cx.get('source_evidence',{})
    print(f"=== {i+1} {t['revision_key'][:8]} {cx.get('section')} | {cx.get('source_tag')} | {se.get('component')} {se.get('public_source_path')} lines={se.get('matching_lines')}")
    print("keys:",[k for k in cx.keys()])
    print("SRC:",repr(t['source']))
    print("TGT:",repr(t['target']))
    if cx.get('adjacent_translations'): print("ADJ:",json.dumps(cx['adjacent_translations'],ensure_ascii=False)[:600])
EOF
